messages:
maya: Quick follow-up from the hotpath incident analysis. We spotted a recurring pattern: cache cold-writes + long prefixes cause cascading decode/backpressure in the runtime. Need concrete testing + ownership so this doesn't slip.

maya: Proposed breakout: (A) Incident-derived prompt corpus + adversarial seeds (owner: @quentin). (B) Regression harness that runs cached vs cold traces and asserts latency deltas (owner: @ana). (C) Nightly/PR load runs that include a "warm->cold" transition profile (owner: @jordan). (D) Add incident label taxonomy so we can group regressions by pattern.

quentin: I'll pull the last three incidents and curate ~120 unique prompts. Plan to include metadata: model, seq_len, cached_prefix_len, token_cost. I'll add a small script to sample adversarial truncations + repeated-token blasts.

ana: ack (typo: ana). For the regression harness I want to add deterministic seeds + a KV snapshot so we can reproduce hot vs cold. Suggest storing artifacts in gs://redwood-evals/incident-archives/2026-06-cache-cold.

jordan: For load runs I propose a composite k6 profile: 1) steady baseline, 2) sudden 3x burst, 3) rapid client reconnects to exercise reconcilers. Capture per-request token latency and runtime queue depth. We'll make the profile runnable in CI staging and nightly.

maya: Ops ask: tie any blocking CI eval to an exemption flow and a short-lived bypass token so product experiments don't get blocked indefinitely. Also we need a severity-to-action mapping: Sev2-> 2 week SLA for tests; Sev3-> monthly.

quentin: q: Where do we keep the canonical "golden" prompts? Current repo is inference-evals/prompt-sets but we should create a structured layout: /incidents/<id>/prompts.json + metadata.json.

ana: +1. Harness will accept a path `--artifact gs://.../incidents/2026-06-cache-cold/prompts.json`. Will also output a JSON summary with P50/P95/P99 deltas for cold vs warm. Example command: ```./regress run --suite incident_cache_cold --artifact gs://redwood-evals/incident-archives/2026-06-cache-cold --model redwood-v2 --assert delta_latency_pct<10```

jordan: note on thresholds: we should set thresholds per-model/per-profile based on historical baseline. I'll export baselines from metrics-db and attach to ENG-3124.

opsbot: Created tickets ENG-3124 (warm-cold load profile), ENG-3125 (incident prompt corpus), ENG-3126 (regression harness + CI gating).

maya: Let's also add a small autotriage label in the incident flow: `pattern:cache-cold` and `impact:tail-latency` so we can query for recurrence. That will help prioritize adding new prompts when similar incidents appear.

quentin: I'll include a short README with guidance: how to add new prompts, how to mark them as "adversarial", and an example mapping from prompt -> expected behaviour (e.g., cold path >2x latency).

ana: CI gating idea: non-blocking by default, but fail the merge if a regression is >20% on main baseline. For blocking behavior we require on-call approval and an RFC in the ticket.

jordan: scheduling: aiming to land artifacts + initial CI runs this week, full nightlies next week. I'll coordinate infra quota for the k6 runs.

maya: timeline recap in tracker: ENG-3125 prompt corpus (quentin) due Fri; ENG-3126 harness + CI (ana) due Mon; ENG-3124 load profile (jordan) due next Wed. Will add these to the incident follow-up board.

quentin: 👍 filing PR tonight with first 40 prompts & metadata.

ana: I'll open a draft PR with harness + integration tests. Need reviewers from eng-runtime for KV snapshot schema.

jordan: I'll run a smoke burst in staging tomorrow 09:30 and tag runtime oncall.

maya: thanks all. one more ask: capture a short post-drill note after the first nightlies so we can refine thresholds and add more adversarial seeds.

opsbot: Reminder: incident retrospective scheduled 2026-06-30 14:00.
